title: Smooth bomber rotation — 120 ms angular lerp instead of instant snap
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-27-015 (could-priority, KABOOM-CREW-CHARACTERS). Direct response to playtest feedback 'человечки поворачиваться должны чуть анимировано а не резко менять направление'. Pure visual polish — gameplay logic stays instant on the GridMover direction; only Transform.rotation.y interpolates.

Bundled with several non-sprint fixes shipped earlier in the session: bench accessory dropdown actually updates (PR #189), accessory sway calmed then disabled (PRs #190 + #191), shield actually absorbs blast (PR #193, the high-impact playtest bug). Those are tracked here for context but each had its own PR + isn't a sprint story.

stories.title: Elapsed-time angular lerp + shortest-path math
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomber-face-movement-system.ts — extended with three pure helpers (shortestAngularDeltaDeg, stepYawLerp, SMOOTH_ROTATION_DURATION_MS=120ms). Elapsed-time-based lerp avoids Zeno-paradox decay (a naive current→target each-tick fraction never converges). Shortest-path math handles wrap-around (175° → -175° goes +10°, not -350°).
verification: acceptance: bomber-face-movement-system.ts exports the 3 pure helpers + the system uses a per-bomber FacingState (currentYaw, targetYaw, startYaw, elapsedSec) so changes to target reset the lerp start + elapsed. 1775/1775 vitest green (was 1762; 13 new tests in bomber-face-movement-system.test.ts).

stories.title: Pure-function + system-level tests
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/bomber-face-movement-system.test.ts — 13 new tests: 6 for shortestAngularDeltaDeg (zero, CW/CCW, wrap-around both directions, ±180 deterministic), 5 for stepYawLerp (elapsed ≤ 0, ≥ duration, ~14% per fixedUpdate, converges over 10 ticks, the 120ms constant), 2 for the system (single tick covers a fraction, 0°→270° goes shortest-path via -90° monotonically).
verification: acceptance: bomber-face-movement-system.test.ts has 22 tests total (9 pre-S157 + 13 new). All pass.
